title: Zesty Umami Ukrainian Prawns Dumplings
description: A gluten-free Ukrainian dish featuring prawns and dumplings, perfect for a date night, with a focus on umami flavor and crumbly texture.
instructions: In a large bowl, whisk together buckwheat flour, potato starch, and a pinch of salt.
Add the egg to the bowl and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until it becomes smooth and pliable.
Divide the dough into small pieces and roll each into a ball.
Flatten each ball into a disk shape and place a prawn in the center of each disk.
Fold the dough over the prawn to form a half-moon shape and press the edges together to seal.
Bring the mushroom broth to a boil in a large pot and add the dumplings.
Reduce the heat to a simmer and cook the dumplings for 10 minutes.
Melt the butter in a small saucepan over medium heat and add the thyme, salt, and pepper.
Serve the dumplings hot with the melted butter sauce and garnish with parsley.
